decisions: Version discovery may be automatic when the canonical stable source is reachable; installation is never authorized merely by discovering a newer version.
Run update awareness once at the first Sloar repository turn and once after intentional fresh-chat resume/takeover, not on every user message.
If installed equals stable, stay silent unless version details were requested. If stable lookup fails, mark update status unknown and continue ordinary repository work without polling loops.
Positive user approval enters the existing safe UPGRADE_SESSION; negative approval leaves the installed release unchanged and should not be re-asked in the same chat without a later user request.
The local Wizard remains network-free; hosted agents resolve canonical stable from capabilities actually available in the current session.
Repository durable state always outranks checkpoints and conversation memory.
